english.title: Young person being employed on casino / betting / adult gaming centre premises - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a young person aged **(..SPECIFY AGE..), were employed to perform a function on premises in respect of which

(A)_[a casino premises licence]_
(B)_[a betting premises licence]_
(C)_[an adult gaming centre premises licence]_

had effect
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 55(4) and 62(2)(b) of the Gambling Act 2005.

english.notes:
(i) Section 45 of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that "young person" means an individual who is aged 16 or 17.
(ii) Section 55(2) of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that the offence does not apply
(a) to employment at a time when no activity is being carried on in reliance on the premises licence, or
(b) to employment on a part of premises which are being used for a regional casino at a time when that part is not being used for the provision of facilities for gambling.
